LanguageData.RJW_Hero.headerTip: Designate pawn as the <color=yellow>Hero</color>. A <color=yellow>Hero</color> can be directly ordered to do lovin' with other pawns.
LanguageData.RJW_Comfort.headerTip: Designate pawn as a comfort pawn. This pawn will then be used by others to relieve their pent-up needs.
LanguageData.RJW_BreedHumanlike.headerTip: Designate pawn for breeding. The colony animals will try to breed this pawn.
LanguageData.RJW_BreederAnimal.headerTip: Designate animal as a breeder. These animals will try to breed pawns designated for breeding.
LanguageData.RJW_BreedAnimal.headerTip: Designate animal for breeding. The colony animals will try to breed this animal.
LanguageData.RJW_Whore.headerTip: Designate pawn as a prostitute. Prostitutes provide service to guests for silver.
